title: On the live target, every SENSITIVE generation has no eligible provider while hfspace is down
current_behavior: With providers hosted1,hfspace and hfspace returning 503, any turn that draws on memory/documents/goals/non-clean history, runs a tool, is an Engineer or image turn, and every unclassified background generation is routed only to hfspace; once its circuit opens, plan() has no candidates and the request fails with AllProvidersFailedError (503). Only context-free chat is served by hosted1.
expected_behavior: A SENSITIVE-capable provider is always available, or the operator consciously raises the hosted ceiling; readiness distinguishes 'sensitive-capable provider down' from healthy.
recommendation: Restore hfspace on an always-on GPU flavor or add a second SENSITIVE-capable node; add a readiness/alert signal for sensitive-capable provider health; document the consequence in control-plane.md next to AURA_LLM_PROVIDERS. Do not raise hosted1 to sensitive without an owner decision (ADR-030 section 4).
confidence: High (code) / Med (live state is a status-doc claim)

title: Admission and quota limits are per process; the VPS stack runs 4 gateway workers plus Celery workers against a single Ollama slot
current_behavior: Effective concurrency on Ollama is 1 x number of processes; overflow queues inside Ollama until the 180 s timeout. Per-minute hosted quota windows are also per process, so N processes can each spend the provider's RPM.
expected_behavior: One shared limiter per capacity group across processes, and a measured concurrency matrix (GAP-041).
recommendation: Build the Redis-backed cross-process admission/quota controller the module docstring names, or run inference-facing processes with AURA_WORKERS=1; run tests/load on the real topology.

title: Embedder, cross-encoder and Whisper weights are loaded by name with no revision; the LLM is an Ollama tag
current_behavior: An upstream Hub push silently changes embeddings (the index identity guards by model id only), rerank scores and transcripts; the Ollama model can change on image/weights pull.
expected_behavior: Every weight artefact pinned by revision/digest and recorded in index identity and telemetry.
recommendation: Add *_MODEL_REVISION settings for embedding, rerank and STT, pass revision= to the loaders, include it in EmbeddingResult.model_id; pin the Ollama model by digest or serve via vLLM --revision.

title: HF Space inference image is unpinned (vllm/vllm-openai:latest); model revision optional
current_behavior: A Space rebuild can change vLLM behaviour; without VLLM_MODEL_REVISION the served weights can change silently.
expected_behavior: Rented plane pinned like the on-host compose: image digest and mandatory model revision.
recommendation: Pin the Space base image by tag+digest with a deliberate bump policy; make VLLM_MODEL_REVISION required in entrypoint.sh (fail loudly like the API-key check).

title: No path from a trained LoRA adapter to served traffic; the production trainer trains nothing
evidence: grep: no caller of OllamaProvider.create_model/warm_model; aura_core/api/admin.py:565-611 uses list/pull/delete only
current_behavior: Approval -> job -> NOT_TRAINED on every live target (scripted trainer). With worker-training, a SUCCEEDED job registers a CANDIDATE whose adapter directory the kernel refuses to serve; no merge/convert/create step exists.
expected_behavior: Learning yields a servable, evaluated model version, or the capability is described as dataset curation only.
recommendation: Build the merge -> GGUF -> create_model -> canary step behind RegressionGate, or relabel the capability in status docs and the client.

title: ADR-030 hosted inference is live on Railway but Phase 6 is unproven, and the proof workflow targets a VPS whose host key changed
current_behavior: Production traffic goes to a hosted provider whose 429/cooldown path, Redis-persisted quota and real fallback were never exercised on a live stack; the only report is in-process, 9/10 with the 429 burst skipped, against OpenRouter rather than the provider documented for hosted1.

title: Native Ollama adapter reports every completion as finish_reason=stop
evidence: grep done_reason in providers/ollama.py: no match
current_behavior: A done_reason 'length' truncation is reported as a clean stop; kernel and telemetry cannot see truncation. Production uses openai_compatible against Ollama /v1, so impact is limited to kind=ollama deployments.
expected_behavior: done_reason mapped to FinishReason as the OpenAI adapter does.
recommendation: Read done_reason in complete() and in the final stream event.

title: Structured-output requests exclude every default-configured provider
current_behavior: Any request with response_schema is refused by every provider whose SUPPORTS_JSON_MODE was left at the default false; Railway's setting is UNKNOWN.
expected_behavior: Boot-time warning when no enabled provider supports JSON mode while a feature needing it is on.
recommendation: Add the boot check; set the flag in the documented Groq slot example; expose exclusion reasons in the admin routing explain.

title: Image understanding is implemented but has no eligible provider on any target
current_behavior: Image turns fail with dependency_unavailable or degrade to OCR text: hosted1 is third party (refused images), hfspace is text-only by default and down, AURA_VISION_ENABLED defaults to false; the client attach UI ships anyway.
expected_behavior: A pinned VLM pool, or the client UI hidden until one is available.
recommendation: Follow docs/deployment/inference-plane.md:118-138 on an always-on Space, or gate the client UI on readiness vision availability.

title: Prompt budget is global (400 tokens), sized for CPU Ollama, and also caps fast hosted providers
current_behavior: RAG/memory context is cut to 400 tokens before routing regardless of provider; on Railway with an 8k-context hosted model this limits grounding unless the dashboard overrides it (UNKNOWN).
expected_behavior: Prompt budget derived from the selected provider's context window or configured per pool.
recommendation: Make max_prompt_tokens a per-provider/pool ceiling, or document the override for hosted-primary topologies in control-plane.md.
